# Civics Study (civicsstudy.com)

> Civics Study is the oral-format practice tool for the 128-question 2025 USCIS civics test. You hear or read one question at a time, answer out loud, then check yourself, the same way the real naturalization interview works. No multiple choice.

## Key facts about the 2025 civics test

- Applies to Form N-400 applications filed on or after October 20, 2025.
- 128 official questions. The officer asks up to 20 and you need 12 correct to pass.
- The officer stops once you reach 12 correct (pass) or 9 incorrect (fail).
- The test is oral and in English, unless you qualify for an exemption.
- 65/20 special consideration: if you are 65+ with 20+ years as a permanent resident, you study 20 marked questions, are asked 10 and need 6 correct, and may test in your own language.

## Features

- All 128 official USCIS civics questions, organized by category, with English and Spanish versions
- Oral-style study: one question at a time, answer out loud, self-mark confident or needs practice
- Audio playback of questions
- Mock interviews that follow the real rules: up to 20 questions, stop at 12 correct or 9 wrong
- Answers for your own senators, representative and governor by ZIP code
- 65/20 mode with only the 20 marked questions
- Progress tracking and interview-date countdown
- Works offline as an installable web app
- Free to start; optional one-time unlock, no subscription

## About

Built by Michael Downey (Vamp Creatives), who built it while studying for his own naturalization interview and passed in May 2026. Civics Study is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with USCIS or any government agency.
